arguments.text: Defence submitted that summons were received late and requested complete copies of charge documents.
Defence argued that the dispute is purely civil in nature arising out of a property contract.
Defence demanded original or certified bank statements to verify transaction entries.
Defence objected to repeated non-appearance of prosecution witnesses causing trial delay.
Defence submitted that PW-2 is intentionally avoiding court appearance.
Defence argued that electronic call records produced by prosecution lacked the mandatory electronic evidence certificate.
Prosecution submitted that electronic records were generated from regular server logs.
Prosecution submitted electronic evidence certificate along with compliance report.
Defence cross-examined PW-3 on financial ledgers and highlighted discrepancies in dates.
